title: Pasta Salad
description: A refreshing pasta salad made with al dente pasta, fresh vegetables, feta cheese, and a light homemade dressing. Perfect as a side dish or a main course with optional protein upgrades.

ingredients.title: For the Pasta Base
items: Farfalle or penne pasta – 250 g (al dente)

ingredients.title: For the Salad Mix
items: Red onion – 1 small (finely sliced, soaked in ice water)

ingredients.title: For the Dressing (Emulsion Style)
items: Red wine vinegar – 2 tbsp (or white balsamic for a softer touch)
Salt & freshly cracked black pepper – to taste

ingredients.title: Optional Upgrades (For Luxury Plating)
items: Toasted pine nuts or walnuts (for crunch)
Grilled chicken, smoked salmon, or prawns (protein upgrade)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Cook the Pasta
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until just al dente.
Drain, toss with a drizzle of olive oil, and spread on a tray to cool (prevents sticking).

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare Vegetables
steps: Roast bell peppers until slightly charred, peel skin, and slice.
Soak onions in ice water for 5 minutes to mellow sharpness.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Make Dressing
steps: In a bowl, whisk Dijon, vinegar, honey, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking to create a light emulsion.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Assemble Salad
steps: In a large chilled mixing bowl, combine pasta, vegetables, and herbs.
Toss with dressing just before serving.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plating (Restaurant Style)
steps: Serve in shallow white bowls for contrast.
Garnish with microgreens, a drizzle of olive oil, and toasted pine nuts.
Add a protein upgrade if making a main course version.

servingSuggestions.title: Pairing Suggestions
items: White wine: Sauvignon Blanc or Pinot Grigio (bright acidity balances richness).
Red wine: Light Pinot Noir (if served with smoked salmon or chicken).

chefTips: Cook the pasta just until al dente for the best texture.
Cool the pasta before mixing to prevent sticking.
Toss with dressing just before serving for the freshest flavor.
Use toasted pine nuts and microgreens for a restaurant-style finish.
